scope: One host (the owner's workstation), Docker bridge network, edge-runtime pinned by lab/functions-image.lock.json (v1.77.4, sha256:ad45164b7548bf5820ed7be714789c17ac2865edce79a09cfb4c3756c3d365a8) started standalone as fnr-* throwaway containers with default Docker flags, a test main service (main/index.ts) and a probe function (probe/index.ts). Not a Sbarbase runtime, no gateway, no environment network. A worker is reused by service path, so each variant ran on a freshly restarted container. A listener was not started on the host, so the host reach rows show a connection attempt from the container, not a served response.
